admission_price: Ages 3 & up: $10, Ages 2 & under: FREE. Activity tickets $1 per ride (Zip Line and Kiddie Carts). Field of Screams $15.
activities: 8-acre corn maze; mini corn maze; tunnel maze; straw maze; hay bale pyramid; corn crib; pumpkin patch (u-pick); sunflower fields; farm animal viewing; photo areas; zip line; kiddie carts; touch a tractor; fire pit rentals; Field of Screams (haunted corn maze); farm stand
season_dates: September 25 - November 8, 2026. Fridays 2 PM - 10 PM, Saturdays 11 AM - 10 PM, Sundays 11 AM - 6 PM.
extra_notes: Cash and card accepted. Private events and field trips available Tuesdays–Thursdays. Fire pit rentals available for up to 30 people for 3 hours (firewood included). Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult in corn maze. Zip line riders must be under 250 lbs. Kiddie carts for children up to 50 lbs. Concessions include popcorn, cotton candy, marshmallow kits, Italian sodas, chips. Beverage stand offers beer, ciders, and local wine (ID required, 21+). Food truck (Mary's Tacos) on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays. No outside food or drink allowed. Photographers can book private sunflower field sessions Tuesdays–Thursdays, 4–6 PM for $149. Farm stand requires no admission.
